Name: Ghostwood Crook - Invisible Animal Fences
Author: MrGlim
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Ghostwood Crook[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A shepherd's crook carved from pale ghostwood. Livestock heed the fences it draws, though no one else can see them.[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]
The Ghostwood Crook lets you lay down [b]phantom fences[/b]: invisible fence tiles that keep your farm animals (and, by default, your pets) where you want them, while you and other farmers walk straight through. No gates to open, and no fence posts spoiling the look of your farm.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Buy it from Marnie's Ranch[/b] for 2,500g (the price is configurable, and setting it to 0 removes it from the shop).[/*]
[*][b]Optional crafting recipe[/b], off by default: 10 Hardwood + 5 Void Essence (ingredients are configurable).[/*]
[*][b]See the fences while you hold the crook:[/b] phantom fences show up as a faint, pulsing, ghostly overlay. Only the player holding the crook sees them.[/*]
[*][b]Placement preview[/b] on the tile under your cursor: [color=#6ee06e]green[/color] = place, [color=#e06e6e]red[/color] = remove, [color=#aaaaaa]gray[/color] = out of reach.[/*]
[*][b]Hold and drag to paint[/b] whole lines of fence (or erase them).[/*]
[*][b]Blocks farm animals[/b] (chickens, cows, ducks, pigs, modded animals and so on), both when they wander and when they pathfind. Ducks can't hop over them either.[/*]
[*][b]Blocks pets[/b] too (you can turn this off).[/*]
[*][b]Doesn't block[/b] farmers, villagers, monsters, horses or Junimos.[/*]
[*][b]Works in any location[/b], including inside barns and coops.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer support:[/b] the host keeps the final say, fences are saved with the farm, and they sync to every player.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support (optional).[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]How to use it[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Put the crook in your hotbar and [b]select it[/b] so it's your held item.[/*]
[*]While you hold it, every phantom fence nearby appears as a ghostly fence, and the tile under your cursor is highlighted:
[list]
[*][color=#6ee06e][b]Green[/b][/color]: clicking will [b]place[/b] a phantom fence.[/*]
[*][color=#e06e6e][b]Red[/b][/color]: clicking will [b]remove[/b] the phantom fence there.[/*]
[*][color=#aaaaaa][b]Gray[/b][/color]: too far away. By default you can reach 1 tile around you, like a tool (see [i]Range[/i] in the config).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Press the [b]use-tool button[/b] (left click, [b]C[/b], or controller [b]X[/b]) on a tile to place or remove a fence piece.[/*]
[*][b]Hold and drag[/b] (keep the button held while you move the mouse or walk) to paint a line. The drag keeps doing whatever the first tile did (place or remove).[/*]
[*]While you're holding the crook, the button's normal behavior (placing, stowing, left-click interactions) is turned off, so it won't do anything else by accident.[/*]
[/list]To see the fences [i]without[/i] holding the crook, press [b]LeftShift + G[/b] (configurable) to toggle "always show".

[size=4][b]What the fences block[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Farm animals:[/b] [color=#6ee06e]Yes[/color], just like a regular fence.[/*]
[*][b]Pets (cats, dogs, turtles...):[/b] [color=#6ee06e]Yes[/color] by default ([i]BlocksPets[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]Farmers (you and other players):[/b] [color=#e06e6e]No[/color], you walk right through.[/*]
[*][b]Villagers, monsters, horses, Junimos:[/b] [color=#e06e6e]No[/color].[/*]
[/list]If you put a fence on a tile an animal is standing on, it can still walk [i]off[/i] that tile (so it can't get stuck), but it won't walk back in. Fencing off the tile in front of a barn or coop animal door stops the animals from going out, the same as a regular fence would.

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] in the mod folder (it's created the first time you run the game with the mod), or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game.
[list]
[*][b]Price[/b] (default [b]2500[/b]): price at Marnie's. [b]0[/b] removes it from the shop.[/*]
[*][b]EnableCraftingRecipe[/b] (default [b]false[/b]): adds a crafting recipe. It's learned automatically on the next day or save load.[/*]
[*][b]CraftingRecipeIngredients[/b] (default [b]"709 10 769 5"[/b]): recipe ingredients in game format ([i]id count id count ...[/i]). The default is 10 Hardwood + 5 Void Essence.[/*]
[*][b]Range[/b] (default [b]1[/b]): how far (in tiles) from your tile you can edit (0 to 10).[/*]
[*][b]DragToPaint[/b] (default [b]true[/b]): hold the button to paint or erase several tiles.[/*]
[*][b]OverlayOpacity[/b] (default [b]0.45[/b]): opacity of the ghost overlay (0.05 to 1).[/*]
[*][b]BlocksPets[/b] (default [b]true[/b]): phantom fences also block pets. In multiplayer the host's setting is the one that counts.[/*]
[*][b]ToggleAlwaysShowKey[/b] (default [b]LeftShift + G[/b]): toggles showing the fences without holding the crook.[/*]
[*][b]MaxTilesPerLocation[/b] (default [b]5000[/b]): safety cap per location, enforced by the host.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]The host must have the mod installed.[/b] The host runs the farm animal and pet AI, so the host's copy is what actually blocks animals, and only the host saves fence data.[/*]
[*][b]Every player who wants to see or edit fences should install it too.[/b] Farmhands without the mod can still play normally, and animals are still blocked for everyone because the host simulates them. Those farmhands just can't see or edit fences, and a crook in their inventory will show up as an error item.[/*]
[*]Fence tiles are stored in each location's save data, which the game saves with the farm and syncs from the host to farmhands automatically.[/*]
[*]When a farmhand clicks, their game sends a small request to the host. The host checks it (right location, within reach) and applies it, then it syncs back to everyone. The farmhand sees their change right away while it waits for the host.[/*]
[*]If a farmhand has the mod but the host doesn't, the farmhand gets a message saying fences can't be edited.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Requirements and compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Requires[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Built and tested with [b]SMAPI 4.5.2[/b] on [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b], on [b]Windows[/b]. It hasn't been tested on macOS, Linux, Android, or in split-screen co-op yet. If you try it there, please let me know how it goes in the comments or bug reports.[/*]
[*]It adds a single new item (the crook) and one Harmony patch on the game's collision check. That patch only [i]adds[/i] collisions for farm animals (and pets, if enabled). It never removes a collision, so it shouldn't interfere with other mods' fences, buildings or pathing. Mods that change animal movement or collision in unusual ways could still interact with it; please report anything odd.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] (you should end up with [b]Mods/GhostwoodCrook/manifest.json[/b]). You can also use a mod manager such as Vortex or Stardrop.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Phantom fence data is just a string in each location's save data, so removing the mod is harmless: the fences stop working and the data is ignored. Any Ghostwood Crooks in inventories or chests will turn into error items, so sell or trash them first if you like.

[size=5][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
Type these in the SMAPI console window:
[list]
[*][b]ghostwood_count[/b]: shows how many phantom fence tiles are in your current location.[/*]
[*][b]ghostwood_clear[/b]: removes all phantom fence tiles in your current location (host only).[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]FAQ[/b][/size]
[b]Q: I placed fences but my animals still walk through.[/b]
A: In multiplayer, the [b]host[/b] must have the mod installed, because the host runs the animal AI. Also check that the fence line has no gaps. Hold the crook (or press LeftShift + G) to see every tile.

[b]Q: Other players can't see my fences.[/b]
A: Fences are only drawn for a player who has the mod and is holding the crook (or has "always show" turned on). Players without the mod never see them, although animals are still blocked for everyone.

[b]Q: Can an animal get trapped inside a fence tile?[/b]
A: No. An animal standing on a tile when you fence it can always walk off it. It just can't walk back in.

[b]Q: Will it block my horse or villagers?[/b]
A: No. Only farm animals and (optionally) pets are blocked.

[b]Q: Can I craft it instead of buying it?[/b]
A: Yes. Set [i]EnableCraftingRecipe[/i] to [i]true[/i] in the config. The recipe is learned automatically on the next day or save load.

[b]Q: Does it work inside barns and coops?[/b]
A: Yes, it works in any location.

[size=5][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The host must have the mod for fences to work at all in multiplayer. A farmhand's copy can't block animals by itself.[/*]
[*]Players without the mod can't see or edit fences, and a crook they're carrying shows up as an error item.[/*]
[*]Fencing off a barn or coop animal door keeps the animals inside, the same as a regular fence would.[/*]
[*]Only tested on Windows so far (see Compatibility).[/*]

[/list][size=5][b]AI disclosure[/b][/size]
I made this mod with a lot of help from AI, and I'd rather be upfront about it:
[list]
